program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (piece obj)
      (let* ((norm (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj)))
             (bb (bbox-of-cells norm)))
        (list (obj-color obj) norm (+ 1 (third bb)) (+ 1 (fourth bb)) (obj-size obj))))
    (define (piece< a b)
      (cond [(not (= (nth a 4) (nth b 4))) (< (nth a 4) (nth b 4))]
            [else (< (first a) (first b))]))
    (define pieces (sort (map piece (objects g 0)) piece<))
    (define widths (map (lambda (p) (nth p 3)) pieces))
    (define hh (if (empty? pieces) 1 (max-list (map (lambda (p) (nth p 2)) pieces))))
    (define ww (if (empty? pieces) 1 (+ (apply + widths) (max 0 (- (length pieces) 1)))))
    (first
      (foldl
        (lambda (p state)
          (let* ((out (first state))
                 (offset (second state))
                 (color (first p))
                 (cells (map (lambda (cell) (list (first cell) (+ offset (second cell)))) (second p)))
                 (painted (paint-cells out cells color)))
            (list painted (+ offset (nth p 3) 1))))
        (list (empty-grid hh ww 0) 0)
        pieces))))
